timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hey, what's going on everyone? My name is Nick Sappanaro. I'm one of the developers and
co-founders of the Divi project. I'm here at Divi HQ today to tell you a little bit about
myself, what I do here, and what I do for fun. I came on board with Divi, I guess it was
mid last year, actually around this time last year. And I was originally brought on just
to build a simple website for them. And after working with them for a couple of months,
they actually offered me a co-founder position. And we really got to work at that point. Because
originally we were using a WordPress site. And I told them if we're going to do this,
we've got to do it right. So that's when I built the first iteration of the website.
I was the only developer at the time. And from there we just continued to build and grow.
So we have what we have today. I usually get here around 9 a.m. and I try to brush up on news,
things that are going on in the market, things other companies are doing both inside the
cryptocurrency space as well as out. And then I take a look at our daily activities. We
have a stand-up meeting every morning with all the developers that are here in this office.
And I play pretty much the product manager role here as well as being a developer. So I
will have that stand-up meeting. It's about 10 minutes long where we basically just talk
about what needs to be done, what's been done this week, and what needs to be finished
before the end of the week. And then we get to work. Coding pretty much all day long,
and we get to work until the end of the week.
I do pretty much what everyone does. Watch TV, Netflix, play video games, stuff to get
pigs. And when that's not taken up by time, I do enjoy producing music. I've been a
music producer for about five years. And I love DJing. When I have the time, I did that
professionally for like three and a half years before starting Divi.
Well, it was really fun letting you guys get to know me a little bit better. I really
like to get to know you guys a little bit better. So please comment below with your favorite
music and what kind of animals you guys have as pets in your homes. Next up, we have
Kalani coming up because our other music head in the office. So be sure to like and subscribe
so you can catch that one. And I'll see you guys next time.
